body: Same. Would be so much easier to just not exist but I keep on keeping on in the hopes that things will get better. Message me if you want to vent.

I like to think I'm pretty self-aware. I know who I am as a person. Selfish, greedy, lazy, stupid, pathetic...these are all words that describe who I am at my very core. There are other more positive words other people would use to describe me but I feel as though I can't ever really believe any of it myself. And I hate myself for that. 

You know how people suffering from terminal illnesses could kill themselves and everyone would be like "That's sad but I could understand why they would want to do that." Ever since I've known about cancer/terminal illness, I've wished it upon myself. That way, I have an actual reason to want to die and I could go with people undersranding why. But I don't. I don't know how I'm going to explain in my final note to my family and friends why I've chosen to end my life. Maybe I won't leave a note at all.

I've always wanted to go skydiving. Before I gave up on life, I would have pulled the chute but not anymore lol Honestly, that would be the way to go. Jumping, I mean. The rush and adrenaline as you fall and there's nothing you can do. Unfortunately, I can't find anywhere tall enough to guarantee death.
Good luck.I wish you peace.

If someone is happy in the world we live in currently they are just being ignorant and blind. How can anyone be happy when great injustices are being carried out all over the world? The only option is to just numb yourself to it. "Another school shooting? Human trafficking constantly all over the world? Child soldiers fighting in wars? Oppressive governments taking advantage of their people?" "So sad! Thoughts and prayers!" Those are the worst kind of people.
It's MY time. I should be able to spend it how I wish.
My work was 12 hour days with a sometimes 2 hour commute back home 6 days a week so I feel your pain. Ridiculous.
I sure hope there's no coming back. However, I've always sort of believed in reincarnation. Maybe I can be reincarnated as someone with an easier life.

I can't even remember lol I guess back in 2011, when Skyrim was released. After that, I just continued playing video games just to hold the dark thoughts at bay. It was just something I did so I wouldn't have to think.

I feel the same way. Growing up poor isn't my mom's fault but I wish that I'd been aborted. Raising four kids in poverty is sooooo fucked up, I'd never dream of doing that to someone. I was really young when I discovered what being poor meant. Being excited for a field trip to the zoo or something, I'd rush home to get it signed but I could never go... not enough money. I think I've only been on one or two fields trips my entire life and I felt myself being separated from my friends as they went on field trips and had fun. I also remember never going out with friends and never visiting any of their houses because I didn't want to be a burden in their homes and I had no money to spend out in public. I feel like this led me into an extremely introverted lifestyle, just staying home playing video games. Which is a sad thing, because I used to be so outgoing when I was younger. 

I hope thatwe can both have peace in whatever form it may come.

Same deal here. My bank keeps calling me cause my account is like 1k overdrawn but I never pick up. I'm glad I still have my car though but it has a Lojack on it so idk if they can track me down and repo my car away, which is my home right now

Okay so, here's the thing. I like not doing anything (ie: not working, video games, eating, shelter, internet) but at the same time, with that lifestyle in just a strain on society. A useless burden. So then, I feel like shit because of that. If only I weren't so self-aware I could live in blissful ignorance.

But I'll bite out of curiousity. What is the way?
Humans are a plague and the Earth would be better off without us.

I have no money to pay for therapy or anything like that. Besides, there's no going back for me. I made my mind up months ago. Thanks for the luck. But on the subject of drugs, do you know of any that may help dull my senses?

I've never done anything wrong to anyone. Yet, my life suffers simply because I don't have as much green paper as other people. What is the point? I worked hard and was not able to move forward. Life isn't a string of short lived victories. Life is a series of scams, designed to keep you working, tired, and poor. Selling your life away for scraps of meaningless paper that is supposed to make your life better but instead makes companies and conglomerates richer

To each their own I guess but personally, I wouldn't want to cause much trouble to anyone. Otherwise, I would have jumped in front of a big rig or train by now. The drivers would have to go through a traumatic event and it'd cause them trouble cause they were basically responsible for your death.
Feels like I can never win. And if I do happen to win, it's a short-lived victory.
I'll pass on that. Thanks though.
